component.name: LGL Emoji Picker
component.summary: Pick and copy emojis to clipboard

description.p: A fast, keyboard-driven emoji picker with search and recent emoji history. Triggered via a keyboard shortcut (e.g. Super+Alt+E), copies selected emoji to the system clipboard, and stays open for repeated use.
Built with GTK 4 and libadwaita, it follows the desktop's dark mode, accent colour and GTK theme, and re-themes live when the theme changes.

ul.li: Moved from Qt 6 to GTK 4 and libadwaita.
Follows the desktop theme, including live changes to ~/.config/gtk-4.0/gtk.css.
Launching the picker again brings the open window to the front.
Recent emoji history from earlier versions is kept.
Hovering over an emoji now shows a tooltip with the emoji name.
Added visible keyboard focus selection and Space/Enter activation.
Reduced search clearing pauses by reusing emoji grid buttons.
